title: Spatial Contract v1 -- Confidence and Abstention Result
$comment: New in Stage D1 -- no prior draft schema covered this record type. This is the fourth non-negotiable record type (Phase D prompt: 'calibrated abstention/retake/human-review signals'). It is the ONLY record type authorized to gate whether a result is released as an authoritative automated score versus routed to retake / human review / abstain. It must be backed by measured calibration evidence (calibration_policy_id + measured_false_accept_rate_at_decision), never by a criterion_decision_result.confidence value alone -- see the release_gate_is_calibrated_not_self_reported semantic rule enforced by validate_phase_d_contracts.py, which fails any RELEASE_AUTOMATED record missing that evidence. This directly operationalizes the Phase D prompt's non-negotiable: 'Model self-reported confidence is diagnostic metadata, never a release control.'

scope.description: CRITERION: this decision covers one criterion_decision_result. RESPONSE: this decision covers a whole response's release status (e.g. capture-quality-driven retake, or 'too many unable_to_determine criteria to release any automated score').

criterion_decision_id.description: Required (non-null) when scope is CRITERION; must be null when scope is RESPONSE.

cited_criterion_decision_ids.description: For scope=RESPONSE, the full set of criterion_decision_result IDs this response-level decision aggregates over. Empty only for scope=CRITERION (which uses criterion_decision_id instead) or for a capture-quality-only abstention made before any criterion decision exists.

model_self_reported_confidence_echo.description: Echoed from criterion_decision_result.confidence purely for audit traceability. Must NOT be the sole or primary input the calibration_policy weighs -- see $comment. Null when scope=RESPONSE and no single criterion confidence applies.

self_consistency_agreement_rate.description: Majority-vote/self-consistency agreement rate, if the calibration_policy used it (Engine 4 FAR investigation found this signal works; see project_engine4_far_investigation_2026_08_18). Null if not computed for this decision.

verifier_agreement_rate.description: Independent-verifier agreement rate, if available (e.g. the DECISION-0045 Gemini/Qwen verification pass). Null if not computed for this decision.

capture_quality_disposition.description: Echoed from the response's capture_quality_result.CAPTURE_DISPOSITION, if relevant to this decision.

input_signals.description: Raw signals the calibration_policy consumed. This object records what fed the decision; it is not itself the release gate.

calibration_policy_id.description: Versioned identifier for the calibration function/thresholds applied (e.g. a policy fit against a held-out calibration partition). Every RELEASE_AUTOMATED decision must cite a real, measured policy -- an ad hoc or hardcoded threshold with no calibration_policy_id is not a conforming v1 record.

measured_false_accept_rate_at_decision.description: The held-out-measured false-accept rate associated with this policy/threshold combination at the time this decision was made. Required (non-null) whenever decision is RELEASE_AUTOMATED. May be null only for ABSTAIN_* / RETAKE_REQUIRED decisions, where no release claim is being made.

decision.description: RELEASE_AUTOMATED: an authoritative automated score may be shown. Per program-wide policy (see docs/research/grading_phase_d_spatial_2026_07_27 CROSS_SUBJECT_MAPPING.md / SPATIAL_CONTRACT.md and memory feedback_no_human_grading_in_production), this value must never be produced by V1 tooling in a live AP Statistics shadow deployment -- Stage D1 defines the record shape now so D6/D7's 100%-human-reviewed shadow gate can measure calibration against it without redefining the schema later; the shadow rollout itself will not set decision=RELEASE_AUTOMATED for any real learner response until an owner-approved bake-off says otherwise.
